mapper.select: SELECT node_id, parent_id, node_name, node_level, node_type, max_level, icon, sort_order, mqtt_server_addresses, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM system_deployment WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order, node_id

SELECT node_id, parent_id, node_name, node_level, node_type, max_level, icon, sort_order, mqtt_server_addresses, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM system_deployment ORDER BY sort_order, node_id

SELECT dd.nav_node_id AS nodeId, COUNT(*) AS deviceCount, SUM(dd.device_deploy_name NOT LIKE 'MOCK_%') AS realCount FROM device_deployment dd WHERE dd.is_deleted = 0 AND dd.nav_node_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dd.nav_node_id

SELECT dd.device_deploy_id AS deviceDeployId, dd.device_deploy_name AS deviceDeployName, dd.device_alias AS deviceAlias, dd.status AS status, dd.n4_address AS n4Address, dt.device_type AS deviceType, dt.manufacturer AS manufacturer, dt.model AS model, (dd.device_deploy_name LIKE 'MOCK_%') AS isMock FROM device_deployment dd LEFT JOIN device_template dt ON dd.device_tmpl_id = dt.device_tmpl_id WHERE dd.is_deleted = 0 AND dd.nav_node_id = #{nodeId} ORDER BY dd.device_deploy_id

SELECT dd.device_deploy_id AS deviceDeployId, dd.device_deploy_name AS deviceDeployName, dd.device_alias AS deviceAlias, dd.status AS status, dd.n4_address AS n4Address, dt.device_type AS deviceType, dt.manufacturer AS manufacturer, dt.model AS model, (dd.device_deploy_name LIKE 'MOCK_%') AS isMock FROM device_deployment dd LEFT JOIN device_template dt ON dd.device_tmpl_id = dt.device_tmpl_id WHERE dd.is_deleted = 0 AND dd.device_deploy_id = #{deviceDeployId}
SELECT node_id, parent_id, node_name, node_level, node_type, max_level, icon, sort_order, mqtt_server_addresses, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM system_deployment WHERE node_id = #{nodeId}

SELECT node_id, parent_id, node_name, node_level, node_type, max_level, icon, sort_order, mqtt_server_addresses, is_deleted, create_time, update_time FROM system_deployment WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY sort_order, node_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO system_deployment (node_name, parent_id, node_level, node_type, max_level, icon, sort_order, mqtt_server_addresses) VALUES (#{nodeName}, #{parentId}, #{nodeLevel}, #{nodeType}, #{maxLevel}, #{icon}, #{sortOrder}, #{mqttServerAddresses})
mapper.update: UPDATE system_deployment SET node_name = #{nodeName}, parent_id = #{parentId}, node_level = #{nodeLevel}, max_level = #{maxLevel}, icon = #{icon}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, mqtt_server_addresses = #{mqttServerAddresses}, update_time = NOW() WHERE node_id = #{nodeId}

UPDATE system_deployment SET node_name = #{nodeName}, parent_id = #{parentId}, node_level = #{nodeLevel}, node_type = #{nodeType}, max_level = #{maxLevel}, icon = #{icon}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, mqtt_server_addresses = #{mqttServerAddresses}, is_deleted = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE node_id = #{nodeId}
mapper.select: SELECT dd.device_deploy_id AS deviceDeployId, dd.device_deploy_name AS deviceDeployName, dd.device_alias AS deviceAlias, dd.status AS status, dd.n4_address AS n4Address, dt.device_type AS deviceType, dt.manufacturer AS manufacturer, dt.model AS model, (dd.device_deploy_name LIKE 'MOCK_%') AS isMock FROM device_deployment dd LEFT JOIN device_template dt ON dd.device_tmpl_id = dt.device_tmpl_id WHERE dd.is_deleted = 0 AND dd.nav_node_id IS NULL ORDER BY dd.device_deploy_id
